title: Exact preparation run
statement: Let $k$ be a nonnegative integer and let $w$ and $s$ be Boolean words. Starting with the preparation machine in state $(0,\mathrm{false})$, with input head at position $1$, with $s$ stored on the first work tape and every other work tape blank, and with all work heads at position $0$, after exactly $2(|s|+1)$ steps the machine is in state $2$ with all work heads at position $0$, the input head at the saturated position for $s$, the first tape still storing $s$, and every scratch tape storing the unary word of length $|s|+1$. The Boolean flag in this final state is true exactly when $|w|<|s|$.
replaced:
For every input $w$ and candidate $s$, exactly $2(\abs{s}+1)$ silent steps
of the preparation machine from the canonical anchored configuration whose
stored words carry $s$ yield the prepared configuration, in which every
scratch tape holds the unary word of length $\abs{s}+1$ and every head is at
displacement $0$.
